scope: Target I under the frozen n3=708 rootless integrally indecomposable endpoint and trace(A_-1 A_-2^2)=0

derived_lemmas.label: DERIVED
derived_lemmas.name: actual_incidence_fixed_point_model
derived_lemmas.statement: For a triangle T={t0,t1,t2}, each Xi=N(ti)\T has size 12 and carries its within-fibre perfect matching gi. The unique cross-fibre neighbour maps fij:Xi->Xj are perfect matchings. After transport to X0, the R3-neighbours of T are exactly the fixed points of sigma=f20*f12*f01.

derived_lemmas.label: DERIVED
derived_lemmas.name: endpoint_q_and_relation_degrees
derived_lemmas.statement: Writing q(T)=12-fix(sigma), the exact relation degrees are deg_R3(T)=12-q(T), deg_R2(T)=3q(T), deg_R1(T)=180-3q(T), and deg_R0(T)=20+q(T). Hence the frozen 708 unordered R2 pairs imply sum_T q(T)=472.

derived_lemmas.label: DERIVED
derived_lemmas.name: three_leg_overlap_formula
derived_lemmas.statement: For two fixed points x,y of sigma, their two R3-neighbour triangles have exactly m_T(x,y) cross edges, where m_T(x,y) is the number of the three transported within-fibre matchings that pair x with y. Consequently the forbidden motif count is sum_T #{unordered {x,y} subset Fix(sigma_T):m_T(x,y)=2}, and the frozen mixed trace is twice this sum.

derived_lemmas.label: DERIVED
derived_lemmas.name: rootless_no_double_overlap_condition
derived_lemmas.statement: Under trace(A_-1 A_-2^2)=0, for every actual triangle T no edge on Fix(sigma_T) belongs to exactly two of the three transported within-fibre matchings. Pairwise intersections of their restricted edge sets therefore equal their common triple intersection.

derived_lemmas.label: DERIVED
derived_lemmas.name: R3_triangle_uniqueness_from_projector_Gram
derived_lemmas.statement: With M=21P0=J+3N^T N-N^T A N, disjoint triangle pairs with j cross edges have M-entry 1-j. If three marked rows are pairwise R3 then their Gram entries are all -2 and their sum is zero. Thus an R3 edge has at most one common R3 neighbour.

derived_lemmas.label: DERIVED
derived_lemmas.name: global_triple_overlap_cap
derived_lemmas.statement: At the endpoint there are (231*12-472)/2=1150 unordered R3 edges. Lemma 5 makes the R3 triangles edge-disjoint, so there are at most floor(1150/3)=383 of them and at most 1149 central triple-overlap events in total. This cap does not force a double overlap.

finite_local_control.label: CANDIDATE
finite_local_control.purpose: attack and delimit the one-centre actual-incidence route; not endpoint evidence

complete_restricted_factor_search.domain: all 11^3 ordered triples of factors from one fixed canonical K12 one-factorization

completion_neighbourhood_search.domain: all six-neighbour core patterns with exactly two neighbours per fibre, assigned defect endpoints, current lambda/mu caps, and no fixed-transversal closure

strongest_self_objection: The new no-double-overlap condition is exact but only a reformulation until compatibility among different triangle centres and the full 231-row projector/Schur identities is enforced. The finite control proves that one-centre q(T)=2 incidence, even after closing all six defective cross edges and saturating several lambda/mu equations, does not force the motif; it says nothing about global extendibility.
